post.summary: Start an email/password signup (always 202, no account enumeration)
post.description: Does NOT create the account. Always answers 202 { status: "pending_verification" } for a well-formed body, whether or not the email already has an account. In the background: no account → a 6-digit code is emailed (60s cooldown, max 5 codes/24h, both silent); existing account → a "you already have an account" email (max 1 per 15 min); deleted account → nothing. Finish with POST /auth/signup/verify. The password is validated here but NOT stored: send it again to /auth/signup/verify.

post.summary: Confirm a pending signup with the emailed code and create the account
post.description: Creates the user (email already verified), accepts pending trainer invites for the email and returns tokens. The password sent here becomes the account password. 400 emailVerification.invalidCode covers wrong code, no pending signup and email already registered (indistinguishable). 400 emailVerification.codeExpired, 429 emailVerification.tooManyAttempts (5 per code) → request a new code via /auth/signup/resend. Rate limited per IP and per email (429 request.rateLimitExceeded).

linkedTrainers.description: Number of trainer invites accepted for this email

post.summary: Sign up through a trainer invite code (no 6-digit email code)
post.description: Closed-beta signup for an invited trainer. The TF- invite code proves inbox ownership, so the account is created with a verified email, the trainer role and the invite is accepted, all in one transaction. The email comes from the invite (see GET /invite/preview). Password rules are the same as /auth/signup/verify. Errors: 404 invite.notFound, 403 invite.revoked / invite.expired, 409 invite.alreadyAccepted, 409 trainerInvite.accountExists (the email already has an account, including a deleted one: sign in and redeem via POST /invite/redeem), 400 validation.failed (e.g. password shorter than 8). Rate limited per IP (429 request.rateLimitExceeded).

post.summary: Reset password using the emailed code
post.description: The code is bound to the email it was sent to. Unknown email, deleted account, missing/used/expired code, wrong code and too many attempts (5 per code) all return the same 400 `PASSWORD_RESET_INVALID_CODE` / `passwordReset.invalidCode`. Dispatch: when `email` is present the body must carry `code` (new contract; if `token` is also sent it is ignored). Without `email`, the deprecated `token` field (old mobile versions) is accepted while the temporary legacy path is enabled: it is matched against all active codes, answers the same 400 invalid code unless exactly one matches, is throttled by global 30/min and 100/hour buckets, and is switched off by a circuit breaker after repeated wrong codes until restart. When the legacy path is disabled or neither field is usable, a missing code answers 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` / `passwordReset.codeRequired`.

code.description: 6-digit reset code sent via email (valid for 15 minutes, 5 attempts)

token.description: Legacy field of old mobile versions (the same 6-digit code, sent without email). Temporary: removed after the mobile release that sends email + code.

delete.description:
Soft-deletes and anonymizes the authenticated user's account. Required by App Store guideline 5.1.1(v) and Google Play's account deletion policy.

- Linked social/email accounts (Google/Apple/email), refresh and password-reset tokens.
- Address, social networks, health details, preferences, metabolic profile.
- Workout sessions (and their exercise/set logs).
- Anamnesis responses, AI conversations, gamification records (points, challenge participation).
- Trainer-student / nutritionist-patient links where this user is the student/patient.
- Trainer invites addressed to or redeemed by this user (both by `userId` and by email — see below).

- Subscription and payment records (`StudentSubscription`), kept for tax/accounting obligations independent of the erasure request.
- Any `TrainingProtocol`/`DietProtocol` assigned to this user (trainer/nutritionist-owned content, not deleted by the student's own request).

Irreversible. The access token already issued remains valid until it naturally expires; only refresh tokens are revoked immediately.

post.summary: Finalize the response on the student's behalf (trainer) — awaits the student's confirmation
post.description: Same validation as the student submit (required visible questions, answers of hidden questions dropped, unknown question 404). The body must carry attestation.studentPresent=true. The response is stored with filledBy "trainer", trainerAttestedAt=now, studentConfirmedAt=null, so its status is "awaiting_confirmation" until the student calls POST /my/anamneses/{anamnesisId}/response/confirm. The trainer may re-finalize their own submission (this resets the confirmation) but never overwrites a response submitted by the student (409 ANAMNESIS_RESPONSE_SUBMITTED_BY_STUDENT) nor one filled in by another trainer (409 ANAMNESIS_RESPONSE_FILLED_BY_ANOTHER_TRAINER; allowed when that trainer's user was deleted). The student must be linked to the trainer and active on the plan, and this trainer must have linked this anamnesis to this student (404 ANAMNESIS_NOT_LINKED_TO_STUDENT otherwise).

The student must be linked to the trainer and active on the plan, and this trainer must have linked this anamnesis to this student (404 ANAMNESIS_NOT_LINKED_TO_STUDENT otherwise).

patch.summary: Save a partial (draft) response on the student's behalf (trainer)
patch.description: Same semantics as PATCH /my/anamneses/{anamnesisId}/response/draft: only the answers present are upserted, empty values clear the stored answer, required questions are not validated. Unlike the student route (which keeps returning 409 ANAMNESIS_RESPONSE_ALREADY_SUBMITTED once the response is submitted), a response this trainer already finalized (or whose filler's user was deleted) is REOPENED as a draft: submittedAt, studentConfirmedAt and trainerAttestedAt are reset to null and the status becomes "draft" until the trainer finalizes again with POST (which re-sets the attestation and "awaiting_confirmation"). While reopened the trainer dossier returns 404, the student cannot confirm (409 ANAMNESIS_RESPONSE_NOT_AWAITING_CONFIRMATION) and the student may still save drafts. A response the student submitted (409 ANAMNESIS_RESPONSE_SUBMITTED_BY_STUDENT) or another trainer filled in (409 ANAMNESIS_RESPONSE_FILLED_BY_ANOTHER_TRAINER) is never reopened and nothing is written. The student must be linked to the trainer and active on the plan, and this trainer must have linked this anamnesis to this student (404 ANAMNESIS_NOT_LINKED_TO_STUDENT otherwise).

post.description: Finalizes the response: validates required visible questions, replaces all stored answers with the payload and marks the response as submitted (status "submitted"). If a draft was saved earlier via PATCH /my/anamneses/{anamnesisId}/response/draft, it is converted into the submitted response. The response becomes student-authored (filledBy "student") and confirmed (studentConfirmedAt set), also when it corrects a response the trainer filled on the student's behalf.

patch.summary: Save a partial (draft) response to an anamnesis
patch.description: Upserts only the answers present in the payload; other stored answers are untouched. An empty value (null, blank string or empty array) clears that question's stored answer. Required questions are NOT validated and answers of currently hidden conditional questions are kept. Drafts are invisible in the trainer dossier (GET /trainer/students/{studentId}/anamneses/{anamnesisId}/response) until the response is finalized with POST /my/anamneses/{anamnesisId}/response; the trainer only sees a student draft through the fill flow (GET .../fill), after attesting the student is present. Returns 409 ANAMNESIS_RESPONSE_ALREADY_SUBMITTED once the response has been submitted.

post.description: Only valid while the response status is "awaiting_confirmation" (finalized by the trainer, not yet confirmed). Sets studentConfirmedAt; answers are left untouched and the status becomes "submitted". Returns 409 ANAMNESIS_RESPONSE_NOT_AWAITING_CONFIRMATION for any other status, and 404 when the anamnesis is not linked to the student or there is no response yet.

overdueAmount.description: Sum of amounts for the overdue payments counted in overdueCount. "0.00" when none.

inactiveStudentsCount.description: Roster students with no completed session in the last 7 days. Read from the cached TrainerBriefingSnapshot — may be up to ~1 day stale.

adherenceMonthPct.description: Current-month adherence rate (0-100), formatted to 2 decimal places. Same value and format as GET /trainer/briefing overallAdherence. Read from the cached snapshot.

adherenceDeltaPp.description: Adherence change vs prior month in percentage points — can be negative. Read from the cached snapshot.

weekPrCount.description: Roster students with a new load personal record in the last 7 days. Computed live.

generatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when this response was generated.

get.summary: Financeiro overview: KPIs and payment rows for a month
get.description: Rows: overdue payments as of today (any month, including cancelled subscriptions), pending payments with dueDate before the first day of the next month (no lower bound), and payments paid inside the month (America/Sao_Paulo window). Overdue = pending AND dueDate < today - 3 days (same rule as GET /trainer/dashboard). Upcoming recurring cycles are generated before the query. Fixed query count, independent of roster size.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: YYYY-MM in America/Sao_Paulo. Defaults to the current month.

overdueGraceDays.description: Days of tolerance after dueDate before a pending payment is overdue

overdueStudents.description: Distinct students with an overdue payment

billedStudents.description: Distinct students with at least one listed payment

delinquencyRate.description: overdueStudents / billedStudents as a 0-100 percentage (2 decimals); 0 when nobody is billed

daysOverdue.description: Days past dueDate; 0 unless effectiveStatus is overdue
